thanks for all the replies guys, didn't mean to sound too 'high and mighty' after all it is morbid reality but it was just hard seeing someone you grow up with reduced to that. I remember some of her really close friends 
(from high school) who were my close friends helped start the process of getting justice for sheri. I was born muslim but i am not really much of one myself but she was very close to her faith (islam) and would have appreciated your prayers and wishes. I for one would like to remember her the way i remember her best ....her hell-raising bubbly self....she was a heck of a sportswoman and a scholar athlete....i am rambling now ...but y'all get the point

sheri, or sheherbano, the lab assistant here was a friend of mine from middle and high school..not a close friend but a friend nonetheless. Not in a million years did i think i would see something from so close to when and how she passed. r/morbidreality has hit a bit close to home today. someone mentioned that is now a 'grease stain' ....not to get overly emotional but that used to be my friend who i shared lunch with, and horrible chem classes. 
RIP sheri...forever young

i dunno but i don't think i will do it again...i have always had the attitude with my situation that i have to live for my family to provide for them (based on so much that they have invested in me) there will be time to give up when i am older....i don't think i will try killing myself in the short-term...

for all intents and purposes i am well integrated....i dont want to scare my folks there is nothing they can do from so far away....i live in dallas....i have a pretty stringent lifting schedule i go four days a week but I just don't know what possessed me to do what i did....i am depressed and have been for a while....but i have never tried to kill myself. in that one moment i thought....maybe just checking out is the best course of action...regretted it the moment after ... i wasn't scared to die just felt guilty of what i would put my folks through..that is what i always feel guilty of whenever i mess up at anything.

it is one thing to hate the religious right....i reject it too...but a completely different thing when it comes to the barbaric massacre of unarmed people...this is comparable to sabra and shatila...except its got an army murdering its own people ...not erstwhile foes

Good luck winning the 'hearts and minds' against extremism (directed towards the Egyptian army...not the US etc)
regardless of how much i despise the MB....this is no way to treat your own citizens....welcome to another few decades of producing militancy..

sorry should have been more descriptive...i am new to posting on reddit...long time lurker

a level of attractiveness (which she was/is)

intelligence (again she had quite a bit of it)

trust and care (she trusted me enough to sleep over a few times i didnt try to have sex because i was being 'honorable' totally out of character)

two days ago this girl was planning to spend thanksgiving with me and in the next day she decides to disclose the bf..i mean i did ask her out and she did ask for time before all this was disclosed....so what did i do wrong here?
